name: Omaha Public Schools
studentCountAsOf: OPS Quick Facts page reviewed August 18, 2026
districtFact: Omaha Public Schools publishes three opening dates for kindergarten and entry-level secondary grades, other K–12 students, and Pre-K. It also publishes separate calendars for Early Childhood and Wilson Focus Elementary, while the district calendar preserves attendance rules for alternative programs and high-school testing days.
calendarNotes: Use the OPS District Calendar for the main K–12 schedule, including staggered opening dates, districtwide no-school days, two-hour late starts, conference weeks, grade-specific high-school testing days, and the last student day. Early Childhood follows the district framework but has additional program-only no-school dates. Wilson Focus Elementary begins and ends on different dates and publishes enrichment sessions, so Wilson families should use its separate calendar. The Spanish district and Early Childhood PDFs are official translations, not different attendance tracks. School-specific activities and later changes may appear on the live OPS calendar or a school calendar. A MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import and does not update automatically.

about.title: One District, Several Calendar Scopes
about.content: OPS publishes a main District Calendar, an Early Childhood edition, and a separate Wilson Focus Elementary calendar. The main calendar also identifies days that apply only to Alternative Education students, kindergarten, seniors, or selected high-school grades.

about.title: Staggered Start by Grade and Program
about.content: The 2026–27 opening is spread across August 19 for kindergarten and entry-level middle and high school grades, August 20 for all other K–12 students, and August 26 for Pre-K. Wilson Focus Elementary starts August 4 under its own calendar.

about.title: Published School Hours
about.content: OPS lists elementary hours as 8:50 a.m.–4:05 p.m. and middle and high school hours as 7:40 a.m.–3:05 p.m. Wilson Focus and Alternative Programs publish or communicate their own start and dismissal times.

districtFaqs.q: Do all Omaha Public Schools students start on the same day?
districtFaqs.a: No. OPS uses a staggered opening. Families should use the date for the student's grade or program. The main district calendar and Wilson Focus Elementary calendar also have different opening dates.

districtFaqs.q: Does Early Childhood follow the main OPS calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Early Childhood shares the main opening, break, late-start, and last-day framework but has additional no-school dates. Families should use the official Early Childhood calendar for those program-specific closures.

districtFaqs.q: Does Wilson Focus Elementary follow the regular OPS calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Not completely. Wilson Focus has its own first and last student days, additional no-school periods, enrichment sessions, and dismissal times. Districtwide holidays, late starts, and conference closures also appear on its calendar.

districtFaqs.q: What do the OPS two-hour late-start dates mean?
districtFaqs.a: The district calendar marks four dates when all students begin two hours later than usual. Families should check transportation and program communications because Wilson Focus and Alternative Programs use school-specific hours.

districtFaqs.q: Are the English and Spanish OPS district calendars different schedules?
districtFaqs.a: No. They are official language editions of the same district schedule. Separate Early Childhood and Wilson Focus files exist because those programs have additional or different calendar dates.

planningTips.title: Planning with the OPS Calendar
content: Match the first day to the student's grade or program; August 19 is not the first day for every OPS student.
Save the four two-hour late-start dates separately from full no-school days and confirm transportation details with the school.
Read the attendance scope on November 10, January 15, and April 6 because those dates affect only certain grades.
Use the Early Childhood or Wilson Focus PDF when the student follows one of those calendars.
Check the live OPS or school calendar for activity times, weather changes, and revisions published after the annual PDF.
